title: docs(dev-novel): remove vanilla stories
body:
**Summary**

"Vanilla stories" are incomplete and redundant with the jQuery stories as they implement widgets with the connectors like the jQuery ones. This PR removes them and in the process, removes their dependency on `bel`.

**Result**

https://deploy-preview-3038--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=Analytics.default

Not much to see here, as there was no tab for this set of stories already.

FIX #3024
